openFindings: 2026-09-02 survey of 20 live transcripts (Claude Code 2.1.229-2.1.241) found SIX event types the parser does not handle. One is content-bearing: `attachment` — 622 of 3,096 events, the second most common type in the sample, and zero of them existed in the March capture. In the same sample there were NO `image` content blocks (March had 4), which suggests attachments moved out of message content into their own event type. Every one is currently dropped by isConversationEvent. Untriaged.
The other five (custom-title, bridge-session, ai-title, atis-latch, mode) look like session bookkeeping and are probably correct to skip, but that has not been confirmed.
